title: Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.16270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$4

translated_title: 基于K近邻图的高效核心集选择
translated_abstract: 核心集选择通过用小型代表性子集替换大型训练集来降低模型训练成本。现有的梯度近似核心集方法（如CRAIG和基于聚类的变体）能保持模型精度，但其选择阶段往往依赖密集的成对距离或大型项目-聚类绑定矩阵，导致在大数据集上产生高昂的时间和内存成本。本文提出KNNG-CS，一种基于$K$近邻图的轻量级核心集选择方法。KNNG-CS利用局部邻域结构来估计每个数据项的重要性，并贪心地选择代表性节点，而无需维护二次距离矩阵。该方法仅需与边数成线性的存储空间。在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，KNNG-CS在达到与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相当的精度的同时，将选择时间减少了$2.3\times$-$4$倍。
tldr: 提出基于K近邻图的轻量级核心集选择方法KNNG-CS，利用局部邻域结构估计数据重要性，避免二次距离矩阵，在保持精度的同时显著降低选择时间和内存开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on K-nearest neighbor graphs that leverages local neighborhood structures to estimate data importance, avoiding quadratic distance matrices and reducing selection time by 2.3x-4x while maintaining accuracy.
